newsitem.title: USA: S.D. 420 MW Big Stone power plant resumes service.
newsitem.headline: S.D. 420 MW Big Stone power plant resumes service.

text.p: The 420 megawatt (MW) Big Stone coal-fired generating station, as expected, resumed service Tuesday following repairs to a boiler tube leak, an onsite official said Thursday.
"It went back to operation Tuesday afternoon," he said.
The power plant, in Big Stone City, South Dakota, was shut Sunday, December 29.
The Big Stone station is operated and majority owned by Otter Tail Power Co. Northwestern Public Service and Montana-Dakota Utilities are other owners of facility.
